title: TOMORROW X TOGETHER Hit the Stage in First Trailer For ‘2026 TXT MOA CON IN JAPAN: LIVE VIEWING’ Concert Film: Watch
summary: The May 24 show from IG Arena in Nagoya, Japan will be broadcast live to cinemas around the world.
contentText:
Unless you live in Japan, chances are you can’t attend TOMORROW X TOGETHER ‘s upcoming seventh anniversary celebrations. But no need to fret MOAs, because on Thursday morning (May 7) the K-pop superstars announced that they will bring the party to you via a global broadcast they’re calling 2026 TXT MOA CON IN JAPAN: LIVE VIEWING on May 24.

The global theatrical broadcast from Japan, the boy band’s first live cinema event in three years, was described in a press release as a “victory lap for the group’s latest musical chapter,” coming on the heels of last month’s release of their 8th mini album, 7th YEAR: A Moment of Stillness in the Thorns .

The 30-second trailer finds members SOOBIN, YEONJUN, BEOMGYU, TAEHYUN and HUENINGKAI rocking out and playing live guitar and drums, striking poses and, of course, hitting their pinpoint choreo in a variety of flashy stage outfits to the strains of their upbeat 2024 pop anthem “I’ll See You There Tomorrow” from that year’s Minisode 3: Tomorrow mini-album.

The MOA CON — TXT’s fans are known as MOA — kicked off with a run of three shows at the KSPO Dome in Seoul, South Korea in February and early March and will continue with the May 24 when the group broadcast live to theaters in more than 50 countries from Aichi’s IG Arena in Japan. The special event presented by Trafalgar Releasing and BIGHIT MUSIC will be a chance for the band’s international fans to watch the anniversary concert featuring a full live band and solo stages highlighting each member’s talents from the comfort of their movie theater seats.

TXT last hit theaters in 2023 with ACT: SWEET MIRAGE: LIVE VIEWING . Last month, 7TH YEAR: A Moment of Stillness in the Thorns landed the boy band their ninth No. 1 on Billboard’s Top Album Sales chart.
